note: Tips shown on the parent page's Record sounds list. The list itself is built from data/kinder/letters.json (letter sounds), data/kinder/cvc.json (words) and data/sight/ (confirmed sight words), so a new letter, word or sight week shows up to record automatically. 'extra' can add more groups later (each item: id = the clip name the games use, e.g. num-7, label, tip).

letters.g: a hard "g" as in goat, not "juh"

letterTip: Say the sound, not the letter name. Short, with no "uh" on the end.
wordTip: Say the word once, clearly, at a normal speed.
